tax.billing_formula: 457.1: amounts charged directly to one company (an operating-company tag, a fixed-entity policy or a work order's benefiting location). 457.2: amounts spread by an approved allocation factor. Direct share = 457.1 / (457.1 + 457.2). Every line carries the receiving company's own Part 101 account (18 CFR 367.27). Amounts with no approved policy stay at the service company and are not billed.
tax.ledger_formula: Allocated cost by FERC account, function, cost class and the rule that placed it (rule id, citation, Regulation or [POLICY]). Totals tie to the period's allocated ledger (control C-10).
tax.listing_formula: Every ledger line booked to the account in the billing period ({usecase}): vendor, description, amount and the invoice it ties to. The invoice opens the invoice-to-ledger view.
tax.listing_csv_header: # Transactions by FERC account {account} {title} | billing period {period} | {entity} | prepared by {user} on {prepared} UTC | source: MM CostIQ {usecase}
tax.rule_register_formula: Dollars by the rule stamped on each ledger line in the period; they sum to the period's ledger total. [POLICY] rows apply as written and show awaiting sign-off until the controller signs them off. 920 is A&G salaries only; a proposed change that would book a non-labor line there is blocked by the guard.
tax.capital_formula: 107 holds implementation cost on a valid work order (open, threshold date set, module not yet ready for use). On the ready-for-use date the balance moves to 351.2, 363.2 or 397.2 by function (Order No. 898) and depreciates through 403, credit 108, at the existing rate: balance x rate / 12 a month. Capitalizable lines without a work order or a threshold date are held out of 107 and expensed.
methodology_ledger: listing_by_account.csv: every ledger line for docket {filing}'s operating company, jurisdiction and test period, by FERC account, with vendor, description, amount, invoice and the rule that placed it. rule_register.csv: the mapping rules with citation, basis ([POLICY] rows await the controller's sign-off) and the dollars each placed for the same company, jurisdiction and period.
